BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE/BARCH   SEMESTER:  V
BRANCH: ALL/ARCH   SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : PE5009 INDUSTRIAL ORGANIZATION AND MANAGEMENT

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Enlist the factors which influence the choice of form of business organization. [2]
 (b) Distinguish between Public Sector and Private Sector Company. [3]


Q2 (a) What are the roles and responsibilities of board of directors in a joint stock company?  [2]
 (b) How  preferential  shares  differ  from  equity  shares?  Explain  different  categories  of
preferential shares.
[3]


Q3 (a) Management is an art as well as science – Justify the statement. [2]
 (b) Discuss the essential functions of management. [3]


Q4 (a) Explain the elements of delegation of power. [2]
 (b) Define span of control. Discuss various types of span of control. [3]


Q5 (a) Why organization structure is necessary? [2]
 (b) Differentiate between line organization and line and staff organization. [3]


Q6 (a) State the utility of organization manual. [2]
 (b) How divisional organization structure can be formed? Explain with example. [3]

Q1 (a) What is Corporation? Discuss its advantages and disadvantages. [2]
 (b) What do you mean by the term “INSOLVENCY” and “BANKCRUPTCY”? Discuss with suitable
example.
[3]

Q2 (a) Define “BONDS”? Discuss its types with an example. [2]
 (b) Is PARTNERSHIP better than SOLE PROPRIETORSHIP? Discuss with the help of example. [3]

Q3 (a) What are the main functions of managers according to Fayol? [2]
 (b) Briefly explain what is a limited partnership? Is it a popular form of business ownership?
Explain.
[3]

Q4 (a) Distinguish between Authority and Responsibility with example? [2]
 (b) Compare private limited company with public limited company and show the advantages
and disadvantages of each.
[3]

Q5 (a) What do you require to know before designing an organizational structure? [2]
 (b) What will be the organization structure for “Hindustan Unilever” according to you? Give
reasons in favor of your choice?
[3]

Q6 (a) Why the line organization is also called Military Organization system? [2]
 (b) What  is  Functional  based organizational  structure?  Discuss  its  advantages  and
disadvantages.
[3]
